item.title: India’s Coal Generation Drops 3% in 2025 as Renewables Cover Demand Peaks: CREA
item.description: India is currently witnessing a clean energy transition, with India’s coal-fired power generation falling by 3% in 2025—only the second decline in a full calendar year in at least half a century, the first being associated with the Covid-19 pandemic. This indicates a trend in which clean electricity sources are increasingly covering demand peaks, making additional coal power capacity increasingly redundant. item.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies Bags Reduced 704 MWac Solar Project Order
item.description: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited (WRTL) announced on Thursday, January 8, that it has received a letter of award for a revised 704 MWac / 1,000 MWp grid-connected ground-mount solar power project. The project revision follows considerations related to evacuation infrastructure and optimisation of DC overloading parameters. item.title: Power Mech Projects Subsidiary Debuts in Energy Storage with 1 GWh WBSEDCL BESS Order
item.description: Power Mech Projects Limited (PMPL) subsidiary PM Green Private Limited has secured a contract for a 1 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) from the West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (WBSEDCL). The company announced in a press release that it has been awarded a 250 MW / 1,000 MWh BESS contract under a Build, Own, Operate (BOO) model, with a 100% off-take guarantee from WBSEDCL. item.title: Envision Energy Enters Brazil Market via 630 MW Casa dos Ventos Wind Deal
item.description: Envision Energy has recently signed a 630MW wind turbine supply and a 30-year long-term service agreement with Casa dos Ventos, a Brazilian renewable energy developer. The company explained in a press release that this project marks Envision's first net-zero energy deployment in Brazil and establishes a broader partnership, delivering AI-enabled, end-to-end renewable energy solutions. item.title: SECI Issues BoS Tender For 700 MW Solar Project In Gujarat
item.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has issued a tender for a 700 MW (AC) ground-mounted solar project in Gujarat. The tender is for the balance of system scope of the project. The project is located at Radha Nesda in Banaskantha district of the state. The scope of work involves comprehensive engineering and construction. item.title: GM to Take $6 Billion Hit as It Scales Back Electric Vehicle Investments
item.description: General Motors (GM) announced on Thursday that it would take a USD 6 billion charge to unwind portions of its electric-vehicle (EV) investments, becoming the latest automaker to scale back in response to the Trump administration’s policies and softening demand for battery-powered vehicles. GM’s EV sales fell 43 percent in the fourth quarter, following the loss of the federal tax credit.
